163: - **Outcome:** Series and modified/deleted occurrences round-trip as one canonical resource.

170: - **Handoff:** Highest-risk packet; publish supported recurrence matrix.

173: 
174: - **Outcome:** DAV matches Happening permissions and never makes imported content writable.
175: - **Depends on:** T06.
176: - **Scope:** Owner/editor/viewer/free-busy, revocation, imported resources, path ownership.
177: - **Changes:** Apply one authorization projection to discovery, reads, reports, PUT, DELETE.
178: - **Out of scope:** New roles/sharing UI.
179: - **Acceptance:** Roles pass the access matrix; revocation is immediate; foreign existence is hidden; imported writes fail.
180: - **Verify:** Table-driven service/HTTP authorization tests.
181: - **Handoff:** Supply matrix and denial codes to T18/T19.

184: 
185: - **Outcome:** Apple edits preserve approved client-owned metadata.
186: - **Depends on:** T14.
187: - **Scope:** Allowlisted alarms, categories, URL, transparency, selected X-properties.
188: - **Changes:** Parse, validate, persist, merge, serialize allowlist; reject scheduling/unsupported components.
189: - **Out of scope:** ATTENDEE/ORGANIZER, arbitrary properties, VTODO/VJOURNAL.
190: - **Acceptance:** Allowed metadata survives unrelated edits; removals persist; unsafe components fail; ETags stay deterministic.
191: - **Verify:** Golden fixtures, normalization properties/fuzzing, Apple-shaped update test.
192: - **Handoff:** Freeze allowlist/examples for docs.
193: 
194: ## T17 — Connection lifecycle UI
195: 
196: - **Outcome:** Users safely set up, inspect, revoke, and disconnect devices.
197: - **Depends on:** T02.
198: - **Scope:** Disconnected, one-time secret, connected, attention, revoke-one, disconnect-all states.
199: - **Changes:** Replace settings stub, wire credential APIs, add copy/setup guidance and accessible errors.
200: - **Out of scope:** Configuration profiles and Apple credentials.
201: - **Acceptance:** Secret appears once; device metadata renders; one-device revoke preserves others; disconnect-all invalidates all.
202: - **Verify:** Frontend tests and Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke.
203: - **Handoff:** T18/T19 reuse setup/error language.
204: 
205: ## T18 — Production hardening
206: 
207: - **Outcome:** DAV fails safely under malformed, oversized, brute-force, or insecure traffic.
208: - **Depends on:** T11, T15, T17.
209: - **Scope:** Parser/body/report limits, DAV rate limits, redacted logs, metrics, HTTPS/proxy validation.
210: - **Changes:** Add bounded middleware/parsers, safe telemetry, and fail-closed production transport checks.
211: - **Out of scope:** General observability redesign.
212: - **Acceptance:** Violations fail before writes; auth throttling is independent; logs contain no credentials/bodies; insecure production config fails closed.
213: - **Verify:** Adversarial suite, redaction/rate tests, production-config smoke test.
214: - **Handoff:** Provide operator checklist and sanitized diagnostics.
215: 
216: ## T19 — Apple compatibility, cleanup, and docs
217: 
218: - **Outcome:** Current macOS/iOS Calendar completes connect, sync, CRUD, and revoke.
219: - **Depends on:** T12, T14, T16, T18.
220: - **Scope:** Real-client acceptance, sanitized fixtures, legacy fake-CalDAV/WebCal cleanup, deployment/user docs.
221: - **Changes:** Test Apple clients; encode protocol differences as regressions; remove misleading scaffold while retaining explicit one-off ICS export.
222: - **Out of scope:** Apple credentials, Apple-side calendar creation/deletion, scheduling, tasks/journals, configuration profiles.
223: - **Acceptance:** Both clients connect; initial/incremental sync and supported CRUD work; revoke fails next request; UI/docs match reality.
224: - **Verify:** Signed device checklist, full DAV/frontend/backend suites, deployment smoke test.
225: - **Handoff:** Release only after this passes; record supported OS versions/limits.
226:

228: 
229: - 19 packets: 2 complete, 17 awaiting approval.
230: - 14 waves with limited safe parallelism.
231: - Highest-risk packet: T14 recurrence semantics.
232: - Release boundary: T19; earlier packets are integration checkpoints.

(End of file - total 232 lines)

318:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
319:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);

321:     let mut first = true;
322:     while pos < chars.len() {

1765:                         let Some(event_id) = change.event_id else {
1766:                             continue;
1767:                         };
1768:                         let resource = match repository
1769:                             .ensure_resource(calendar.calendar_id, event_id, now)
1770:                             .await
1771:                         {
1772:                             Ok(resource) => resource,
1773:                             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1774:                         };
1775:                         match events.event(calendar.calendar_id, event_id).await {
1776:                             Ok(Some(event)) => {
1777:                                 if let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(
1778:                                     accounts.pool(),
1779:                                     calendar.calendar_id,
1780:                                     &resource,

1804:             let event_ids = match repository
1805:                 .list_exposed_event_ids(calendar.calendar_id)
1806:                 .await
1807:             {
1808:                 Ok(event_ids) => event_ids,
1809:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1810:             };
1811:             for event_id in &event_ids {
1812:                 let resource = match repository
1813:                     .ensure_resource(calendar.calendar_id, *event_id, now)
1814:                     .await
1815:                 {
1816:                     Ok(resource) => resource,
1817:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1818:                 };
1819:                 match events.event(calendar.calendar_id, *event_id).await {
1820:                     Ok(Some(event)) => {
1821:                         if let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(
1822:                             accounts.pool(),
1823:                             calendar.calendar_id,
1824:                             &resource,
1825:                             &event,
1826:                             access,
1827:                         )
1828:                         .await
1829:                         {
1830:                             let href = format!(

1842:                 Ok(revision) => revision,
1843:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
1844:             };
1845:         }
1846:     }

1848:     let new_token = accounts.encode_sync_token(new_revision);
1849:     let collection_href = format!("/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{}/", calendar.calendar_id);

2047: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
2048:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
2049:         return Vec::new();
2050:     };
2051:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
2052:         authorize_calendar_action(
2053:             UserStatus::Active,
2054:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
2055:             Some(role),
2056:             action,
2057:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
2058:     };
2059:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
2060:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
2061:     if can_read {
2062:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
2063:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
2064:     }
2065:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
2066:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
2067:     }
2068:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
2069:     if writable {
2070:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
2071:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
2072:     }
2073:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
2074:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
2075:     }
2076:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
2077:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
2078:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
2079:     }
2080:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
2081:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
2082:     }
2083:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
2084:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
2085:     }
2086:     privileges

2221: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event, rendered
2222: /// at the caller's read scope. Free-busy readers receive a placeholder that
2223: /// carries only the time window. Recurring events are serialized as a series
2224: /// (master + exceptions) in a single VCALENDAR.
2225: async fn ical_and_etag(
2226:     pool: &SqlitePool,
2227:     calendar_id: i64,
2228:     resource: &CaldavEventResource,
2229:     event: &Event,
2230:     access: DavReadAccess,
2231: ) -> Option<(String, String)> {
2232:     let timing = match &event.timing {
2233:         EventTiming::Timed {
2234:             start_utc,
2235:             end_utc,
2236:             timezone,
2237:         } => CaldavIcalTiming::Timed {
2238:             start_utc: *start_utc,
2239:             end_utc: *end_utc,
2240:             timezone: timezone.clone(),
2241:         },
2242:         EventTiming::AllDay {
2243:             start_date,
2244:             end_date,
2245:         } => CaldavIcalTiming::AllDay {
2246:             start_date: start_date.clone(),
2247:             end_date: end_date.clone(),
2248:         },
2249:     };
2250:     let status = match event.status {
2251:         EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
2252:         EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
2253:         EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
2254:     }
2255:     .to_owned();
2256:     let free_busy = matches!(access, DavReadAccess::FreeBusy);
2257: 
2258:     // Allowlisted client-owned metadata (T16). Only exposed to detail readers;
2259:     // free-busy placeholders carry only the time window.
2260:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(pool.clone());
2261:     let client_properties = repository
2262:         .load_client_properties(event.id)
2263:         .await
2264:         .ok()
2265:         .flatten()
2266:         .unwrap_or_default();
2267: 
2268:     let recurrence_rule: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
2269:         "SELECT recurrence_rule FROM events WHERE id = ? AND calendar_id = ?",
2270:     )
2271:     .bind(event.id)
2272:     .bind(calendar_id)
2273:     .fetch_optional(pool)
2274:     .await
2275:     .ok()
2276:     .flatten()
2277:     .filter(|r: &String| !r.is_empty());
2278: 
2279:     let ical = if let Some(rrule) = recurrence_rule {
2280:         let exceptions = fetch_recurring_exceptions(pool, event.id, &timing).await;
2281:         let master = CaldavIcalEvent {
2282:             uid: resource.uid.clone(),
2283:             summary: event.title.clone(),
2284:             description: event.description.clone(),
2285:             location: event.location.clone(),
2286:             status: Some(status.clone()),
2287:             timing: timing.clone(),
2288:             dtstamp: event.created_at,
2289:             sequence: event.version as u64,
2290:             free_busy,
2291:             rrule: Some(rrule),
2292:             exdates: exceptions
2293:                 .iter()
2294:                 .filter(|e| e.is_deleted)
2295:                 .map(|e| e.date_value.clone())
2296:                 .collect(),
2297:             recurrence_id: None,
2298:             categories: client_properties.categories.clone(),
2299:             url: client_properties.url.clone(),
2300:             transp: client_properties.transp.clone(),
2301:             alarms: client_properties.alarms.clone(),
2302:             x_properties: client_properties.x_properties.clone(),
2303:         };
2304:         let exception_events: Vec<CaldavIcalEvent> = exceptions
2305:             .iter()
2306:             .filter(|e| !e.is_deleted)
2307:             .map(|e| CaldavIcalEvent {
2308:                 uid: resource.uid.clone(),
2309:                 summary: e.title.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| event.title.clone()),
2310:                 description: e.description.clone(),
2311:                 location: e.location.clone(),
2312:                 status: e
2313:                     .status
2314:                     .clone()
2315:                     .map(|s| s.to_uppercase())
2316:                     .or_else(|| Some(status.clone())),
2317:                 timing: e.timing.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| timing.clone()),
2318:                 dtstamp: event.created_at,
2319:                 sequence: event.version as u64,
2320:                 free_busy,
2321:                 rrule: None,
2322:                 exdates: Vec::new(),
2323:                 recurrence_id: Some(e.date_value.clone()),
2324:                 categories: Vec::new(),
2325:                 url: None,
2326:                 transp: None,
2327:                 alarms: Vec::new(),
2328:                 x_properties: Vec::new(),
2329:             })
2330:             .collect();
